name: Chart/Radial-Chart
description:
Radial chart (ring gauges): 1-4 measures against a max as concentric 10px rings, 8px apart (6px and 4px at Small), round ends, in palette order (Chart/Sector/Primary, Secondary, Support Cyan Solid), each over a dotted Border/Neutral/Subtle track (2px dots every 6px), the lead value in the centre (Heading/4 + Caption/Regular) and a legend below or at the end. Size (code: RadialChart size): Small 120 (the centre figure alone, Body/Base/Bold), Medium 168 (default), Large 240, XLarge 320 (Heading/3 figure). Content only, no surface of its own: place it in a Chart-Card's (or a Card's) Content slot, and the card gives the theme. Code: RadialChart + ChartCard (src/components/Chart)


Color: Primary (default) · Secondary — Secondary swaps Color Chart Sector/Primary and /Secondary (the outer two rings swap), for a chart led by Neutral Deep with the brand as its highlight. Code: palette="secondary".


Header: Title · Show Hint — an info icon (20px, Content/Neutral/Light) that holds the chart's description in a Tooltip (code: hint) · Show Open; Show Icon is off by default (chart headers carry no icon). Metric: Show Metric Label (Body/Small/Regular, what the figure is; code: metricLabel) over Show Value (Display/4).
